domains.label: Spatial Workspace
domains.systemOfRecord: data/spatial/workspace.json + data/spatial/pages.json + data/spatial/intent-state.json + data/spatial/studio-state.json + data/spatial/architecture-memory.json + projectCanonicalSlicesIntoWorkspace + refreshSpatialOrchestrator + pumpAutomatedTeamBoardAsync
domains.mutationAuthority: ui/server.js workspace persistence routes and governed worker flows
domains.notes: Primary live workspace backbone plus governed read aggregation over persisted workspace state, sidecars, canonical slice projection, and orchestrator refresh.

domains.label: Spatial Runtime
domains.notes: Operational runtime projection consumed by Studio and automation refresh flows.

domains.label: AXIOM Active Project Workspace Context
domains.systemOfRecord: AXIOM FileManagerState activeProject/projectRoot/projectManifest + active project's .axiom/project.json workspace declaration + explicit surface-owned state projections
domains.mutationAuthority: FileManagerRuntime governed project-open/manifest flows; scene, authoring, viewport, and connection owners retain mutation authority over their contributed state
domains.notes: Single read-only active workspace aggregate used by Project Preview, BSB Map Forge, workspace identity chrome, and agent/tool context. UI consumers may not guess project identity, roots, source paths, or bake owners independently.

domains.label: Truth Kernel
domains.systemOfRecord: workspace domain plus surfaced evidence artifacts projected through buildTruthKernelPayload
domains.mutationAuthority: read-only projection from refreshed workspace and evidence stores
domains.notes: Read-only spatial substrate of surfaced ACE entities and immediate relationships.

domains.label: Canonical Intent
domains.notes: Canonical authored/request intent state surfaced through the live intent route, workspace intent registry, canonical intake persistence, and read-only downstream field/resolver projections.

domains.label: Spatial Field Influence
domains.systemOfRecord: canonical intent geometry projected through deriveSpatialIntentFieldInfluence
domains.mutationAuthority: read-only projection from current canonical intent
domains.notes: First governed spatial field: buildDesirability only, traceable to one canonical intent.

domains.label: Ghost Projection
domains.systemOfRecord: canonical intent fieldInfluence resolved through resolveSpatialGhostProjection
domains.mutationAuthority: read-only uncommitted projection; execution remains separately governed
domains.notes: Non-committing resolver candidate generated from buildDesirability pressure; never committed world truth.

domains.label: Desk Properties
domains.mutationAuthority: read-only projection from refreshed workspace and QA evidence
domains.notes: Per-desk truth projection used by Studio desk property surfaces.

domains.label: QA Evidence
domains.systemOfRecord: data/spatial/qa/structured/latest.json + data/spatial/qa/*.json + data/spatial/qa/local-gates/*.json + qa lead state + QA investigations/repair state
domains.notes: Mixed QA source-of-record domain spanning structured reports, recorded QA runs, local gates, QA lead state, investigations, and repair-loop evidence.

domains.label: Execution Provenance
domains.systemOfRecord: throughput sessions, planner runs, executor runs, and context-manager run artifacts
domains.notes: Run lineage, timings, and artifact provenance for executions.
